note:
Reviewed opposing identities: The official Japanese account identifies the Japanese attacking squadron and Russian ships Variag and Koreits. Asama and Variag provide representative equipment families, with Variag’s unshielded guns differing from the generic cruiser miniature. Neutral ships involved in rescue are excluded from the opposing forces; quantities remain unreviewed. Unavailable quantities stay empty, so these identities support an illustrative engagement rather than proportional forces.

Equipment review: Asama supplies Japan’s armoured-cruiser component; Variag supplies Russia’s protected-cruiser family. These are equipment families, not exact ship reconstructions: Variag’s guns lacked shields, unlike the generic protected-cruiser miniature. Other cruisers, Koreits and transports are not individually depicted. Neutral rescue ships are not made combatants.
